text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do...?
Did I eat too much cheesecake, or something?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. No matter how many times I look, my skin is breaking out...
Maybe I should ask someone for advice—n-no.
I shouldn't trouble them... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: She asked me for advice about rough skin before! The method I researched back then should still be in my notes...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
They were so grateful to me back then,
but to think they'd end up helping me instead...
*sigh*... I wonder if it'll heal properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame went through trial and error,
trying to do something about her rough skin.
